deploy.startCommand: bash -c 'set -e; LOG=/tmp/startup.log; exec > >(tee -a "$LOG") 2>&1; echo "=== AtomQuest startup $(date) ==="; echo "PORT=$PORT"; echo "--- [1/3] Patching Apache port config ---"; sed -i "s/80/$PORT/g" /etc/apache2/ports.conf /etc/apache2/sites-available/000-default.conf && echo "Port config updated to $PORT" || { echo "ERROR: sed failed"; exit 1; }; echo "--- [2/3] Running database migrations ---"; php sql/migrate.php && echo "Migrations complete" || echo "WARNING: Migrations failed (non-fatal, continuing)"; echo "--- [3/3] Starting Apache on port $PORT ---"; apache2-foreground'
